implementation_source: Independent adaptation from PDF/report and accessible repository concept. The benchmark data lacks genomic coordinates, so genes are ordered by data-driven co-expression anchor assignment instead of random HVG index.
core_mechanism: Gene module sequence modeling with patch tokenization and SSM-style gated depthwise mixer.
scmae_gap: graph-free long-range gene/module dependency modeling while preserving mask prediction and masked expression reconstruction
neighbor_mix_relation: independent; no NeighborMix operator is used and mixed_cell_fraction remains 0.0
